name: Merrick Ham
strengths: Ham converts length into longarm/swim pressure off the edge.
Ham finishes rushes with strip ability — sophomore reel shows longarm-to-swim strip sack.
Ham plays stand-up / wide-9 alignments and keeps tackles off his chest with reach.
weaknesses: Ham still needs to add mass to hold up as an every-down SEC edge.
comparison: Ham comps to Yetur Gross-Matos — long, rangy EDGE with length and hand counters who fills into a productive every-down rusher.
projection: Ham projects as a Year 2 SEC starter at EDGE (package rushes Year 1). Ceiling: All-SEC edge rusher — the long wide-9 piece who wins the corner with length and hand counters once he adds mass.
schemeFit: Ham fits a wide-9 / stand-up EDGE or 3-4 OLB who attacks the arc with length while the frame fills out.
insiderNotes: Ham is a long, rangy EDGE who converts length into longarm and swim pressure, finishes rushes with strip ability, and keeps tackles off his chest from stand-up / wide-9 alignments. Wins with length, hand counters, and reach — a growing every-down rusher as the frame fills.
